title: Cumuless
description: An AI-powered sidekick that drives sales funnels by integrating semantic search across enterprise knowledge bases and communications.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Cumuless connects to an enterprise's knowledge sources (Confluence, Teams, etc.) and makes all content semantically searchable & chattable in a smart, VPC enclosed, user-access aware environment. As the sole developer and Co-Founder & CTO of this startup, I successfully raised $25k in funding while building the platform from August 2023 to December 2024.

sections.title: Key Features
content: AI-powered semantic search across multiple data sources
Secure GenAI chat for generating, summarizing and extracting information

sections.title: Business Impact
content: Reduces 20% of work time spent searching for information
Unlocks value from 80% of unstructured team data
Improves decision making by enabling better information access

sections.title: Use Cases
content: Marketing & Branding: Creating optimized marketing collateral and campaign formulation
Sales & Business Development: Training team members, compressing sales cycles, and creating sales collateral
Customer Success & Retention: Resolving customer queries independently and finding documentation without delay

sections.title: Technical Implementation
sections.content: As the sole developer on this project, I built Cumuless using Next.js for the frontend and Python for the backend. The infrastructure was deployed on AWS using a variety of services including EC2 instances, VPCs for secure networking, and AWS Bedrock for AI capabilities. The platform implements a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture with Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide context-aware responses while maintaining security in a user-access aware environment. The VPC-enclosed architecture ensures that sensitive enterprise data remains secure while still enabling powerful semantic search capabilities.

sections.title: Achievements
sections.content: Raised $25k in funding as sole developer serving as Co-Founder & CTO from August 2023 to December 2024.
